name: a step whose state is one control character
why: A C0 or C1 control character shows a reader nothing: a step would reach the page with a name and no visible state beside it, and JSON.stringify writes the character into the snapshot where a reviewer reading the diff cannot see it either. It is outside the characters a fact may carry, wherever in a value it sits and whether or not it is inside backticks (decided on #27, 28 Oct 2026).
